description: Implementation of the RtnetlinkMessage class and related network message classes for handling rtnetlink messages in the quic namespace.

classes.name: RtnetlinkMessage
classes.description: Represents a rtnetlink message with methods to construct and manipulate network link, address, route, and rule messages.

classes.name: LinkMessage
classes.description: Represents a network link message, with a factory method to create new, delete, or get link messages.

classes.name: AddressMessage
classes.description: Represents a network address message, with a factory method to create new, delete, or get address messages.

classes.name: RouteMessage
classes.description: Represents a network route message, with a factory method to create new, delete, or get route messages.

classes.name: RuleMessage
classes.description: Represents a network rule message, with a factory method to create new, delete, or get rule messages.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::RtnetlinkMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a rtnetlink message with specified type, flags, sequence, pid, and payload header.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::~RtnetlinkMessage
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up allocated message buffers.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::AppendAttribute
methods.description: Appends an attribute to the rtnetlink message.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::BuildIoVec
methods.description: Builds an iovec array for the message.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::IoVecSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the iovec message array.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::AdjustMessageLength
methods.description: Adjusts the message length after adding attributes.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage::MessageHeader
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the message header.

methods.name: LinkMessage::New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new link message based on operation type.

methods.name: AddressMessage::New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new address message based on operation type.

methods.name: RouteMessage::New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new route message based on operation type.

methods.name: RuleMessage::New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new rule message based on operation type.
